description_en: Retrieves the DataAgent memory list (up to 50 memories per RAM user)
description_zh: ListDataAgentMemory 获取DataAgent记忆列表（子账号粒度最多50条记忆）
name: ListDataAgentMemory

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Default value: 50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The content pattern used for fuzzy match search
parameters.help_zh: 内容模式，用于模糊查询搜索
parameters.name: content_pattern

parameters.help_en:
The sort order for the specified sort field. Default value: desc. Valid values:
asc: Ascending order.
desc: Descending order
parameters.help_zh:
指定的排序字段进行升序或降序。默认值为desc。
asc：升序。
desc：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. Default value: hitTimes. Valid values:
hitTimes: The number of hits.
created: The creation time
parameters.help_zh:
指定排序字段。默认值为hitTimes。
hitTimes：命中次数。
created：创建时间
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query memories in all statuses. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询全部状态的记忆。默认值为true
parameters.name: query_all

parameters.help_en:
The memory source. Valid values:
session: Generated from a session.
user: Edited by a user
parameters.help_zh:
记忆来源
会话生成：session
用户编辑：user
parameters.name: mem_from

parameters.help_en:
The source ID.
If MemFrom is set to session, FromId indicates the session ID.
If MemFrom is set to user, FromId indicates the RAM user ID
parameters.help_zh:
来源ID
当MemFrom为session时：FromId表示会话ID
当MemFrom为user时，FromId为用户子账号ID
parameters.name: from_id
